title: TV
description: SVT's live channels in a card. Give this module a screen position of its own (for example bottom right): the picture stays where the card was when it started, so it doesn't follow a card that other cards push around.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel to play. SVT only shows its channels in Sweden. It plays whenever the module is enabled and shown: its schedule and Privacy Mode stop it.

size.title: Size
size.description: The picture's width in pixels; it is always 16:9. Wider than 1280 is more than the Raspberry Pi can show smoothly. Ignored in fullscreen.

output.title: Speakers
output.description: Where the sound goes. The screen only if it has speakers: one without them stays silent.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: How loud, as it sounds (0-100). The Settings tab's volume sets the whole mirror's.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Cover the whole screen with the picture. No other card can be seen meanwhile.
